feature: Dark mode for mobile Home and Notifications
detail: CLAUDE.md says single theme, no dark mode. Commit 27d455b in the worktree adds dark --m-* tokens, stores/theme-store.ts (localStorage 'fieldscout-theme') and a data-theme switch, with comments citing 'Chris, 2026-10-15 — dark mode is mobile-only'. CLAUDE.md needs reconciling, no toggle UI exists yet, and the dark IR pill renders white on white (Q6).

feature: Status bar and home indicator phone chrome
detail: Presentation-only in the prototype, and the indicator is invisible there. The web build has no safe-area-inset handling anywhere in src.

feature: Pressed (:active) states on tiles, league cards and notification rows
detail: The prototype declares pressed backgrounds but never renders them; the app uses hover states only (Q21).

feature: Messages button and DM unread badge on the Home header
detail: No DM schema or API exists. rail/messages-panel.tsx is mock data behind featureFlags.messages, and there is no mobile entry point.

feature: My stuff Lists tile with live count, opening a Profile Lists segment
detail: The lists count can be computed from the lists table. /app/profile is 'My stats' and has no Lists / Rankings / Start-Sit segments.

feature: My stuff Rankings and Start/Sit tiles
detail: Counts can be computed from weekly_rankings.submitted_at and start_sit_questions.voting_closes_at/resolved_at, but both routes redirect to /app while the weeklyRanks and startOrSit flags are off at launch.

feature: Matchups 'Week N' header
detail: The current week is available from nfl_weeks / use-schedule; the prototype has a literal.

feature: League matchup card header (avatar, 'N-team scoring · Week N')
detail: LeagueIndexCard shows name, season, team count, role and status. MyLeagueRow lacks scoring label, week, team name and record, which are in leagues, scoring_systems, teams and standings.

feature: League card live block (teams, records, live points, projections)
detail: Comes from useMatchups scores, use-standings records, teams, and projectedTotal over league_player_values (matchup-view.tsx). A per-user summary endpoint over the existing tables would avoid N×3 requests.

feature: Win probability bar and '% win' on league cards
detail: No win-probability model exists. WinProbMeter in league-cells.tsx is unused, and matchup-view.render.test.ts pins 'no win probability'.

feature: Red alert dot on league card
detail: No trigger is defined (Q9).

feature: League avatar colour assignment
detail: The app crest is an ink tile or avatar_url. There is no rule for which colour a league gets, and Home (white text) and the switcher (dark text) conflict (Q12).

feature: Trending players Adds/Drops with add/drop counts and % rostered
detail: The current card shows Risers/Fallers from projection vs last season (TODO(data)). No add/drop or rostered-% source is synced, and players has no rostered column.

feature: Trending 'See all' to League Players with Available + Trending
detail: leagues/players-page.tsx has a free_agents scope but no trending section, and it depends on trend data.

feature: Injury news feed with recency ('2h') and newest-first sort
detail: injury-news-card.tsx is hard-coded mock data. players.status, injury_* and practice_participation exist (migration 034), but there is no status-change log or timestamp, and no news notes.

feature: 'On your roster · {team}' line on injury rows
detail: Overlap of league_rosters and teams across the user's leagues (leagues flag-gated).

feature: Injury 'See all' destination
detail: The prototype toasts and no destination is defined.

feature: App-only Home content on mobile (Scout AI, Top waiver adds, Recently viewed, AI experts shelf)
detail: Not in the design. CLAUDE.md requires keeping and restyling the AI and persona features, so where they sit on mobile Home needs a decision.

feature: Outside-league tab bar (Home / Community / Players / Profile)
detail: bottom-tabs.tsx has Home / Lists / Players / Search / More. Community is flag-off at launch and the Lists tab would be dropped.

feature: In-league tab bar shown on Notifications
detail: The app has no in-league bottom bar, and the spec shows it on Notifications with nothing active even when arriving from Home (Q3).

feature: League Menu sheet (settings, scoring, playoffs, draft results, history, previous seasons)
detail: more-sheet.tsx is a generic More sheet. League settings, schedule, draft and standings routes exist; League history and Previous seasons have no route.

feature: Notifications 'Mark all read' button
detail: POST /api/notifications/read already marks all read. The page currently auto-marks everything read on open, which contradicts the spec's unread state (Q2/Q18).

feature: Tap a notification row to mark it read
detail: The API accepts ids and the desktop rail panel already marks a row read on click; the mobile page doesn't.

feature: Trade-offer notification deep link to trade detail (Accept / Decline / Counter)
detail: Trade notifications carry trade_id. notificationHref only goes to /app/leagues/[id]/trades (the list). TradeCard in trade-center.tsx holds the actions.

feature: 'Message @user' from trade detail
detail: Needs DMs, which have no backend.

feature: Followed user updated a ranking notification and deep link
detail: Only list_updated (notify_list_followers, migrations 019/038) exists. There are no ranking-follow notifications, Rankings is flag-off, and the route and its Back are undefined (Q19).

feature: Player scored a TD notification
detail: No per-play live scoring notifications exist; score_fanout is an internal queue.

feature: Injury affecting your lineup notification
detail: Needs a job that compares injury status changes with lineups.

feature: Lineup lock reminder notification
detail: Needs a scheduled reminder job.

feature: Prototype edge cases (profile under trade detail, Message path exit, Home under Community overlay, toast-only rows)
detail: Prototype artefacts. Decide the intended behaviour (Q23, Q24).

feature: Small hit targets ('Mark all read', 'See all')
detail: These are 16–17px tall, below the README's 30px minimum (Q22).
